Class TuiBoardRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.tui.game.TuiBoardRenderer
public final class TuiBoardRenderer extends Object
Stateless renderer for the central game board (header, card rows, offer track, order tile and the cursors that float over them). It draws a single immutable TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame snapshot produced by the screen, so it owns no state and never reads back from the controller — mirroring the GUI's BoardRenderer separation.
